about_the_game:
Snooked is a billiards-inspired roguelike game. Pocket enhanced balls in sequence to earn streaks and combine them with unique Companions in order to achieve a higher score.

Features

  • Billiards Roguelike: Position your balls on a creative pattern, try different builds, get better items and discover new Companions

  • Deckbuilding: build your arsenal of billiard balls and enhance them through purchasable items on the shop

  • Physics: hit the perfect shot with accurate physics and improve your skill with challenging levels

Content

  • Streaks: each ball scored adds up to a streak counter, which multiplies your score when redeemed

  • Companions: combine these with previously owned items and streaks to discover new synergies and mechanics

  • Wax: apply to each ball to gain extra points

  • Oil: modify ball mechanics such as speed, bounciness and more

  • Shop: customize your arsenal by buying or selling items on the shop

short_description: Snooked plays like a combination of Balatro and Billiards. Pocket and discover game-changing balls on this strategic and minimalist game of pool. Achieve higher streaks and trigger combos based on the pocketed balls.
